name: Rhahk'Zor
summary: Deep in the Deadmines, Rhahk'Zor drives the work forward by force. As head foreman, he keeps Defias laborers and miners in line while they build Edwin VanCleef's underground fortress.

sections.title: The Foreman of the Deep
sections.body: The Defias Brotherhood has turned Moonbrook's abandoned gold mines into an underground fortress. Rhahk'Zor was appointed head foreman to coordinate the work. He oversees the excavation crews and laborers as they carve tunnels and build VanCleef's secret projects.

sections.title: Brute Motivation
sections.body: Rhahk'Zor keeps order with muscle and an immense stone-headed hammer. Defias diggers and goblin engineers know that defiance or falling behind schedule can bring a crushing blow from the towering foreman.

aliases: who is the ogre boss in deadmines
faq.answer: Rhahk'Zor is an ogre and the Defias Brotherhood's foreman and enforcer in the Deadmines. He watches over the first excavation tunnels and keeps the workforce digging and in line.

faq.q: Why is an ogre working for the Defias Brotherhood?
aliases: why is there an ogre in deadmines
faq.answer: Edwin VanCleef's rebellion depends on the muscle and mercenary talent it can acquire. Rhahk'Zor's strength and intimidation make him a fit foreman for the grueling work of excavating the mines.

faq.q: What is Rhahk'Zor's job in the mines?
faq.answer: Rhahk'Zor oversees construction in the mines. He supervises miners, goblins, and Defias builders as they hollow out caverns, maintain equipment, and build fortifications for the Brotherhood.

faq.q: Where in the Deadmines is Rhahk'Zor located?
faq.answer: Rhahk'Zor is past the first miner tunnels, in the early quarry chambers. He stands in front of the first heavy door leading deeper into the mine.

faq.q: Does Rhahk'Zor have any connection to the ogres from the First War?
faq.answer: Ogres lived in the Deadmines during the First War, before Blackhand's Horde wiped them out. Whether Rhahk'Zor belongs to those earlier clans or is a brute hired by VanCleef remains unconfirmed.

faq.q: What happens when Rhahk'Zor is defeated?
faq.answer: Defeating Rhahk'Zor breaks the Defias hold on the outer quarry and clears the way through the reinforced blast door he guards. The route leads deeper into the clandestine shipyards and workshops.

angles.text: For Alliance adventurers entering Moonbrook, Rhahk'Zor shows that the Defias Brotherhood has grown beyond petty highway banditry into a heavily fortified army.
As a warrior, facing Rhahk'Zor tests your endurance on the front line against a massive ogre swinging a sledgehammer that shatters stone and bone.
As a miner, you see Rhahk'Zor drive workers with crude brutality, turning Westfall's storied old gold mines into a rushed industrial war machine.
